title: Longest Word
description: Read an integer n followed by n words, and print the longest word. When several words tie for longest, print the FIRST one. This is the transfer variant of 'Find the Maximum': same C5 skill (traversing a sequence with valid indices and keeping the best seen so far under a strict comparison), different element domain and comparison. Reusing numeric-maximum code on words cannot produce these answers, and a non-strict comparison picks the wrong tied word.
constraints: Each word has 1 to 50 lowercase letters.
starter_code:
def longest_word(words):
    """Return the longest word (first one on ties)."""
    # TODO: traverse with valid indices and keep the longest seen so far
    raise NotImplementedError


def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    words = data[1:1 + n]
    print(longest_word(words))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
input_format: First line: an integer n. Second line: n words separated by spaces.
output_format: A single word: the longest of the n words (first on ties).
